item: Outlet page furniture listed apart from citations; QID-only sources show their domain
key_paths: src/analytics/link_furniture.py src/api/main.py src/api/source_io.py src/catalog/qid_labels.py src/static/app-core.js src/static/app-sources.js tests/test_article_view.py tests/test_qid_label_resolution.py
summary: Row 68: the reader counted an outlet's footer as citations (apps.apple.com on 494 of 495 hbl.fi articles). A link carried by at least 50% of one source's stored articles, on a source with at least 20, is now listed apart as that outlet's page furniture, with the counts and the method; nothing is deleted. Row 71: a source named only by a bare Wikidata id shows its domain (id on hover) in the reader, article rows, export and the Sources tab; the stored name is unchanged. /api/sources returns the discovery-candidate count and the Sources tab shows it beside the total; the article source filter also matches the domain.
